newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia T.H. Hin debuts at 8.05 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia T.H. Hin debuts at 8.05 rgt.

text.p: T.H. Hin Corp Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board on Monday at 8.05 ringgit, against a 2.80 ringgit offer price.
The maker and distributor of gas cookers and other household appliances offered three million shares. At 0133 GMT, its stock was trading at 8.40 ringgit.
For the year ended August 31, 1996, the company reported a turnover of 48.04 million ringgit, pretax profits of 7.48 million ringgit and net profit of 5.65 million or 67 cents a share.

It has forecast pretax profit of 8.66 million ringgit and net profit of 6.0 million ringgit or 30 cents a share. The earnings per share figure is based on the enlarged share capital of 20 million ordinary shares for the year ending August 31, 1997.
The offer was expected to bring in net proceeds of 8.21 million ringgit.
